The Vanguard Action Squad.text: The Vanguard Action Squad's raid on U.A.'s forest training camp in Beast's Forest is the evening of SATURDAY, August 3, the camp's third night (the class arrives on Thursday, August 1). The squad goes through Kurogiri's gate from the League Hideout Bar that same Saturday evening; nobody moves out earlier. Tomura names the squad at the bar on Friday, July 26, eight days before. Days left to the raid: Saturday July 27 = 7, Sunday July 28 = 6, Monday July 29 = 5, Tuesday July 30 = 4, Wednesday July 31 = 3, Thursday August 1 = 2, Friday August 2 = 1, Saturday August 3 = tonight.
